job.name: unsent-film
job.prompt: A cinematic close-up of a blank unfolded love letter on the desk. A gentle breeze slowly lifts the upper right corner of the paper, revealing the crease and translucent fibers. The paper folds closed softly and slowly reopens, like a sentence almost spoken. A red petal shifts slightly at its base. Preserve all objects and the dark bedroom background; slow physical paper movement, realistic shadows, no hands, no people, no words, no camera cuts. Finish with paper open and still.
